rules.coverageNumerator: Distinct items with a finite score for the metric after deduplication
rules.deduplication: One response per model.name × item_id; lexicographically smallest response_id; identical IDs use the first row in sorted Parquet filename and row order
rules.aggregation: Each model mean uses its available items; average, median and SE are across equally weighted model means
rules.standardError: Sample standard deviation of model means / sqrt(number of retained models); null for fewer than two
rules.metricHandling: Separate statistics and coverage filtering per metric; exclude -1 for safety_llama_score and *_correctness before coverage and aggregation
rules.itemSet: All available items per retained model; no common-item intersection
rules.limitations: Models can cover different item sets; SE assumes independent model means. Converted Parquet revision pins the exact data; observed main revision is recorded separately.
